verdict.rationale: Kling documents its own RESTful API with JWT auth, regional endpoints, an MCP/CLI agent path, a dated API changelog, and per-unit pricing for core generation modes (text/image-to-video, start/end frame, motion control, video input). Nothing shows that UI features such as the Agent workspace, Skills, the node canvas, multi-round post-production, or Elements are reachable through the API, so full UI parity is unproven. missing for 10: documented API coverage of Agent/Skills/node-canvas workflows, API access to Elements, storyboarding and mask re-editing, an explicit UI-API parity statement or OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
